description: This PHP source file defines the class S3ExpressSignature, which extends the S3SignatureV4 class to implement specific signing and presigning functionalities for AWS S3-related requests, particularly with modifications for s3express support.

classes.name: S3ExpressSignature
classes.description: Extends S3SignatureV4 to customize signing and presigning of requests for s3express, including token header modifications.

methods.name: signRequest
methods.description: Signs an HTTP request with AWS credentials, modifying token headers for s3express compatibility.

methods.name: presign
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for an HTTP request with specified expiry, including token header modifications.

methods.name: modifyTokenHeaders
methods.description: Removes the x-amz-security-token header and adds x-amz-s3session-token with security token from credentials.

methods.name: getSigningCredentials
methods.description: Creates a new Credentials object with AccessKeyId and SecretKey from the provided CredentialsInterface.
